To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

face-to-face interactions are crucial for the development and success of transnationalizing law firms and that this is a function of the specific requirements of the legal services industry, the nature of the work of law firms and the role of law firms in the global economy.

(1) face-to-face interaction is a crucial component of law firm transnationalization strategies, (2) the role of face-to face interaction varies between law firms and across the industry as a whole, (3) the nature and significance to law firm transnationalisation strategies of face-to-face is shaped by the specific characteristics of the legal services industry, (4) the nature and importance of face-to-face in transnationalisation strategies is likely to be common across a range of transnational industries
the face-to-face interaction of law firm professionals is a crucial component of their business strategy and that the role of face-toface interaction in the globalizing law firm is complex.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: How does face-to-face interaction influence transnationalization and the success or failure of TNCs?
the role of face-to face interaction in the context of TNCs, and the implications of this for economic development.
the role of face-to face interaction in the globalizing law firm.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
face-to-face interactions continue to play a crucial role in the success of TNCs, even in the context of the globalization of their business activities.
face-to-face interactions are crucial in shaping the transnationalization of law firms.
face-to-face communication is still important for transnationalizing firms, but it is a complex and multifaceted process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the role of face-to face interactions is more complex than simply managing across borders.
face-to-face interactions are a vital component to the success of TNCs.
face-to-face interactions are important in transnationalizing law firms because of the role they have in facilitating the development and maintenance of trust.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the role of face-to face interaction is not just about managing across borders but is a key part of the business model of TNCs.
face-to-face interactions are not simply an add-on to the global economy, but are central to its development and functioning.
face-to-face interactions are not simply an incidental by-product of transnationalization, but are a fundamental part of TNCs' global strategies.
